text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
The victor was none among the three of 
them. Even so, Narita Top Road stood tall, 
proud that she had run a race with no 
regrets.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
In the end, Narita Top Road managed to 
show Admire Vega a glimmer of hope during 
the race—serving as the catalyst that 
would change her.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
If it was for "her" sake, then to ensure 
she wouldn't be forgotten—perhaps she 
needed to run toward the future.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
The Kikuka Sho drew to a bright close. 
Yet, that was only the beginning of Act 
Two— the Tenno Sho (Spring) was waiting 
for her.
